authority: Research consolidation only. docs/canonical/** remains the normative source; this file cannot resolve open decisions or approve production use.
rules: evidence_level is the highest level backed by a cited, independently re-checkable artifact. Bounded private-session observations are recorded in live_observation and never raise evidence_level to LIVE_VERIFIED.
Observed internal protocol is not a licensed API (licensed_api=false). Community bridges/forks are not official SDKs.

Surfaces are never generalised: Zalo OA != Zalo Personal; Meta Pages/Messenger/Instagram/Groups/Personal/Ads/CAPI/Lead Ads are separate; TikTok LIVE/Shop/Business Messaging/Ads/Events are separate; Google Ads API != Google Data Manager API.
Google Ads ChangeStatus/ChangeEvent is polled, never push.
production_approval is NOT_APPROVED for every entry; no approval artifact exists.
synthetic_fixture_refs are provider-agnostic platform tests with fabricated data; they do not test provider contracts and do not raise evidence_level.
